query: What prompt-engineering experiments (batch generation, A/B tests varying personalization, narrative vs expository, question types, temperature) and outcome metrics will isolate features that most boost motivation and comprehension?

response.query: What prompt-engineering experiments (batch generation, A/B tests varying personalization, narrative vs expository, question types, temperature) and outcome metrics will isolate features that most boost motivation and comprehension?
response.answer: Prompt-engineering experiments with batch generation, A/B tests on personalization, and narrative vs. expository styles, along with varied question types and temperature settings, can isolate features boosting motivation and comprehension. Outcome metrics include engagement rates and comprehension test scores.
